mindful that no specific activity is organised for men in the parish, the plan is to set up a men’s friendship group, a bit like the men’s shed co ncept, but more focused on broader activities such as sports, hobbies/crafts, cooking skills, healthcare, wellbeing, benefits entitlement, quiz competitions, board games, visits to tourist attractions, day trips to interesting venues such as herita ge/religious sites, or simply just meeting up for a chat and banter over tea or coffee.
once the level of interest is determined, it is hoped to develop a calendar of events.
an information meeting will take place in the parish centre on

wednesday 28th october at 4.00 pm to gauge the level of interest. so please if you are interested or you know a man who may be interested, you and they are encouraged to come along and see what is on offer.
also tell us what you think could be offered, as there are many people out there with talent, skills and experien ces we could all benefit from.
the group welcomes men from all backgrounds and so please come along, you will be made very welcomed.
we look forward to meeting you. thank you the parish of bangor owes an enormous debt of gratitude to mrs sonia devitt who has the parish safeguarding committee for several years.
she carried out this very important role in prot ecting our children and vulnerable adults with remarkable professionalism and t otal dedication.
as she steps down to fully enjoy her retirement we welcome as her successor mrs elaine mcallister and wish her every success in this demanding role.
